request: Extract only disputes and desired matter outcomes from meaningful portions of each latest message in complete conversation context. Keep the results internal.

start.pass_condition: Mixed input produces only supported dispute/objective proposals, legitimate absence is accepted, and exact support plus private results survive saving and reopening.
counterexamples: NM draft substantiates its own statement
A work request becomes a matter objective
A missing result looks like reviewed absence
start.scope: Original text messages. No general fact extraction, action planning, research, execution or public substantive reply.
start.archive_reuse: None. Uses the current model and authenticated storage boundaries.

pieces.built: One focused prompt body with code-selected first/follow-up headers, two independent collections, owned IDs, exact source passages with support/context distinction and code-derived offsets, independently held invalid units, full-context resource checks and replay validation.
pieces.verification: 59 offline extractor/source-layout tests pass. Scripted tests do not establish semantic model quality.
pieces.registry: Registered the new core module in nm/source_layout.json.

pieces.built: Independent review now supports the focused extraction contract. It checks original evidence and scoped omissions, derives source bindings from checked extraction instead of asking the reviewer to repeat them, accepts reviewed absence, and preserves partial or withheld outcomes. New rendering version disputes_objectives_release_v1 leaves historical v1/v2 replies unchanged.
pieces.verification: 72 focused current/legacy release tests pass. Correct empty extraction is accepted; empty output with omissions is withheld. Saved passage corruption, unknown versions and invalid reviewer IDs are rejected.

pieces.built: The second call now uses only disputes/objectives extraction. Current turn v2 binds its prepared contract to the new release; historical turn v1 remains readable under its original preparation and renderer. All-held source/shape failures can use the same single turn-owned correction allowance; independent valid peers survive partial extraction. No broad response-preparation call occurs in the new turn path.
pieces.verification: 47 authenticated app, turn and recovery tests pass, including exact private source bindings, original complete history, legitimate absence, wrong-label extraction, withheld omission, all-held correction, partial success, save failures, lost acknowledgement and historical replay. Browser semantic acceptance remains next.

pieces.owner: nm/brain/disputes_objectives.py with inseparable release/turn version bindings
pieces.observed_failure: Live model copied source passages with changed capitalization and punctuation. Exact checks held those items and kept valid peers; a second all-held result used the shared correction. Relaxing source identity would conceal the defect.
pieces.fix: Supply complete original messages once as ordered code-owned selectable passages. Model chooses IDs and purpose only; code supplies exact words and endpoints. Partition boundaries are navigation aids, not semantic classifications. Repeated passages have distinct owned IDs.
pieces.durable_versions: New extraction disputes_objectives_v2, release disputes_objectives_release_v2 and turn current_brain_turn_v3 bind the new passage-ID projection together. Historical raw-quote extraction v1/turn v2 and original preparation/turn v1 retain their explicit formats. Missing new IDs cannot silently turn a new snapshot into an old one.
pieces.verification: 71 extractor/source-layout, 82 current/legacy release and 49 handoff checks pass. A second sustained browser conversation removed quote-copy failures but exposed semantic over-extraction from historical context and NM-work instructions; those findings are not marked accepted.

pieces.fix: Define objectives as substantive party outcomes, distinct from NM work. Require an actual latest-message contribution and use history only to resolve it. Remove diagnostic label from extractor input; preserve complete original words.
pieces.verification: 84 focused extractor and authenticated app tests pass. Wrong labels cannot filter or bias extraction input. This is wiring evidence, not semantic acceptance.
pieces.call_impact: No new calls; same focused extraction call.

pieces.fix: Independent reviewer explicitly separates substantive party outcomes from NM deliverables and work restrictions, checks latest-message contribution, and permits original historical support for authorised repair. Focused reviewer input no longer contains the advisory classifier label.
pieces.verification: 87 focused and legacy release tests pass. Label-independent input, scope rejection, valid peers, empty turns and legitimate historical repair are covered. Injected verdicts prove wiring, not model semantic detection.
pieces.call_impact: No new calls; same independent review.

pieces.observed_failure: The five-turn rerun still extracted historical items on a work-only request. An all-held correction attached that request as context. The changed objective was captured, but a separate withdrawal was omitted.
pieces.fix: Interpretation review is now specifically checking accuracy of NM saved understanding. Using existing content for NM work does not assert or reaffirm it. Explicit resolutions and withdrawals are extraction changes. Missing-source correction explicitly permits dropping out-of-scope items or returning empty.
pieces.verification: 89 extractor/turn/recovery checks pass. Real-model semantic recheck pending.
pieces.call_impact: No new routine or conditional calls.

pieces.fix: Review requires selected support for the whole description, recognises withdrawals as independent contributions, and distinguishes checking NM interpretation accuracy from using earlier content for work.
pieces.verification: 87 focused and legacy release checks pass. Real-model detection is not inferred from these checks.

operations.name: label_message
operations.input: Exact current message and full attributed history for follow-ups

operations.name: extract_disputes_objectives
operations.input: Complete original messages as owned selectable passages; no classifier label
operations.output: Private dispute/objective descriptions and source selections

operations.name: review_prepared_response
operations.input: Complete original messages and private proposals; no classifier label
operations.output: Per-unit support verdicts, scoped omissions and greeting selection

remaining: Extraction misses independently expressed disputes when related content appears in objectives.
Independent reviewer both accepts omissions and falsely rejects a legitimate empty extraction.
Verify correction/withdrawal coverage under the final prompt; final browser run stopped before these turns.
Do not gate extraction on diagnostic labels. Three independent signals remain an evaluated candidate, not a production change.
Structured links between disputes/objectives, material facts, actions, uploads/OCR, research, execution and useful substantive replies are outside this narrow slice.

checkpoint.judgment: Source identity, durable versions, bounded correction, private/public separation and replay are implemented. Semantic coverage and independent reviewer precision are not accepted. Stop this prompt iteration; do not advance to broader extraction or classifier replacement.

verification.interpretation: 399 integrated checks preceded the final prompt-only refinements. After those refinements, 89 extraction/turn/recovery and 87 current/legacy review checks passed. These establish mechanics, not semantic acceptance.
